newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tianjin active on buy recommendations.
newsitem.headline: Tianjin active on buy recommendations.

text.p: Chinese drug company Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical Group Corp Ltd was traded actively on Thursday with over 19 million shares changing hands after buy recommendations by several research houses, dealers said.
At 0800 GMT, the shares were trading around US$1.31, up 17 cents, or about 15 percent.

"We like the concept very much. The company is well positioned in Chinese and Western medicine in China. We feel very positive about the potential of western medicine in China," said an analyst at a local brokerage.
